announcements.title: Codex Manager 1.0.0
announcements.summary: The extension is now published as Codex Manager with an English-first interface and an independent package identity.
announcements.content: Codex Manager 1.0.0 introduces an independent Marketplace identity, English as the extension language, and updated product branding. Existing codexManager settings, local account data, backup formats, and compatibility behavior remain unchanged.
